_comment: Standalone test-only model for auth/validate-expectations.sh's own fixtures — not a real store. `secret_thing` is deliberately NOT in the paired expectations file's required_types, and it carries the forbidden `deleter`; a prohibition is a claim about the whole model, so it must be caught there anyway. `secret_thing.editor` is a bare `this` that does NOT include admin, so if relation_includes were ever widened to the whole model too it would produce a second violation — which is what pins the requirement half of the split.
